product_overview: Gezdir Beni is a bilingual small-group tour booking website where visitors can browse tours, view live departure availability, and complete a guest checkout without creating an account. It also lets visitors look up an existing reservation later using a reference code and the booking e-mail.
core_goals: Browse featured and full tour listings
View detailed tour information and available departure dates
Book a tour as a guest by selecting a departure and completing checkout
Look up an existing reservation using booking reference and e-mail
Switch between Turkish and English while staying on the same page
Navigate the site through the header and mobile menu

features.name: Browse tours
features.description: Visitors can discover featured tours on the home page and open the full tour catalogue to compare destinations, durations, group sizes, ratings, highlights, and prices.
user_flows: Navigate to /tr -> View featured tours on the home page -> Open the full tour catalogue -> Browse the tour cards and compare destinations, ratings, summaries, highlights, durations, group sizes, and prices
Navigate to /tr -> Select a tour card -> Open the tour detail page
Navigate to /tr -> Mark a tour as a favourite -> Continue browsing with the favourite state visible during the session

features.name: Tour detail and departure dates
features.description: Visitors can open an individual tour page to read the itinerary, see images and credits, review pricing, and choose from live bookable departure dates with remaining seats.
user_flows: Navigate to a tour detail route -> Read the day-by-day itinerary -> Review the gallery and price -> View the list of departure dates with seats left -> Choose a departure date -> Proceed to checkout with that date preselected
Navigate to a tour detail route -> Review the tour information -> Start booking without preselecting a date -> Proceed to checkout
Navigate to a tour detail route -> Choose to ask a question -> Open the contact mail link

features.name: Guest checkout
features.description: Visitors can complete a single-page booking without an account by selecting a departure, choosing traveller count, entering contact and billing details, and either paying by card now or holding the seat for later payment.
user_flows: Navigate to /tr/tours/kapadokya-balon-rotasi/book -> Choose a departure date -> Choose the number of travellers -> Fill in full name, e-mail, and phone -> Optionally add a note -> Fill in billing address details -> Choose to pay by card now -> Enter card details -> Complete the booking -> See the booking reference and confirmation summary

Navigate to /tr/tours/kapadokya-balon-rotasi/book -> Choose a departure date -> Choose the number of travellers -> Fill in full name, e-mail, and phone -> Optionally add a note -> Fill in billing address details -> Choose to hold the seat -> Complete the booking -> See the booking reference and confirmation summary

Navigate to /tr/tours/kapadokya-balon-rotasi/book -> Start entering booking details -> Submit incomplete or invalid information -> See an error message in the summary panel -> Correct the entered details -> Submit the booking again

features.name: Booking lookup by reference
features.description: Visitors can find an existing reservation by entering both the booking reference and the e-mail used for the booking, then viewing the matching reservation summary in place.
user_flows: Navigate to /tr/reservations -> Enter the booking reference -> Enter the e-mail used for the booking -> Search for the reservation -> See the matching booking summary
Navigate to /tr/reservations -> Enter an incorrect reference or e-mail -> Search for the reservation -> See a not found message -> Start a new search and try again

features.name: Language switching
features.description: Visitors can switch the whole site between Turkish and English while staying on the same page and preserving context.
user_flows: Navigate to /tr -> Switch to English -> Stay on the same page in English
Navigate to /en -> Switch to Turkish -> Stay on the same page in Turkish

features.name: Header navigation and mobile menu
features.description: Visitors can use the fixed header to jump to key sections or pages, and on small screens they can open and close the full-screen mobile menu.
user_flows: Navigate to /tr -> Use the header links to jump to a section or page -> Continue browsing from the selected destination
Navigate to /tr -> Open the mobile menu -> Review the available navigation options -> Close the mobile menu
Navigate to /tr -> Open the mobile menu -> Press Escape -> See the mobile menu close

tech_stack: Separate Node.js/Express 5 booking API on http://localhost:4000/api

routes.description: Turkish home page - hero, featured tours, how it works, why us, reviews, booking lookup panel, closing CTA
One tour - description, day by day plan, gallery, price, and a sidebar listing bookable departure dates with seats left
Single page checkout. Accepts an optional ?departure=<id> query parameter to preselect a date
Find an existing booking with its reference and the e-mail used

features.name: Browse tours
features.description: Visitor sees featured tours on the home page and the full catalogue on the tours page. Cards show photo, destination, rating, summary, highlights, duration, group size and price per person.
user_interactions: Click a tour card anywhere to open its detail page
Click "Tüm turları gör" / "See all tours" to open the catalogue
Click the heart button on a card to mark it a favourite

features.name: Tour detail and departure dates
features.description: Full tour page with itinerary, gallery and photo credits. The sidebar lists open departures with the live number of seats left and a button per date that goes to checkout with that date preselected.
user_interactions: Read the day by day itinerary
See the list of departure dates with remaining seats
Click "Bu tarihi seç" / "Choose this date" on a date to start booking it
Click "Rezervasyon yap" / "Book this tour" to start booking without a date preselected
Click "Soru sor" / "Ask a question" which opens a mailto link

features.name: Guest checkout
features.description: One page booking with no account. Four blocks - trip (departure date and traveller count), contact details, billing address, payment. A sticky summary shows unit price, traveller count and total. Paying by card confirms the booking; choosing to hold the seat leaves it pending. On success the form is replaced by a confirmation showing the booking reference.
user_interactions: Choose a departure date from a dropdown
Choose the number of travellers from a dropdown limited by seats left
Fill full name, e-mail and phone
Optionally fill a note
Fill address line 1, optional line 2, city, postcode and a two letter country code
Choose "Kartla şimdi öde" (pay now) or "Şimdilik sadece yer ayır" (hold the seat)
Fill card number, card holder, expiry month, expiry year and CVC when paying
Submit with "Rezervasyonu tamamla" / "Complete booking"
See an error message in the summary panel when the booking fails
See the booking reference and a summary card on success

features.name: Booking lookup by reference
features.description: PNR style lookup. The visitor types a booking reference and the e-mail used for it; the matching booking is rendered in place. Both must match, so a reference alone reveals nothing.
user_interactions: Type the booking reference, for example GB-7K3M2Q
Type the e-mail used for the booking
Click "Sorgula" / "Find it"
See a not found message when either value is wrong
Click "Yeni sorgu" / "New search" to search again

features.name: Language switching
features.description: The whole site exists in Turkish and English. The switcher in the header keeps the visitor on the same page in the other language.
user_interactions: Click EN in the header to switch to English on the same page
Click TR to switch back

features.name: Header navigation and mobile menu
features.description: Fixed header that becomes opaque on scroll, highlights the section currently in view on the home page, and opens a full screen menu below 768px.
user_interactions: Click Turlar, Nasıl çalışıyor, Neden Biz, İletişim to jump to a section or page
Open and close the mobile menu
Press Escape to close the mobile menu

known_limitations.issue: The hero quick search (destination, date, travellers) is decorative. It looks like a working search box but filters nothing and only scrolls to the tours section.
known_limitations.impact: A visitor can type a destination and a date and expect results; nothing is searched and no feedback explains that.

known_limitations.issue: The departure date and traveller count in checkout are native select dropdowns, not a date picker or calendar.
known_limitations.impact: No way to type or browse dates; only the seeded departures are choosable.

known_limitations.issue: Checkout has almost no inline field level validation. The form uses noValidate and relies on the API rejecting the request, so errors appear as one message in the summary panel rather than next to the field that is wrong.
known_limitations.impact: A visitor with a bad e-mail or a three letter country code is told that some fields are invalid without being shown which one.

known_limitations.issue: Card fields are pre-filled with the test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 and CVC 123.
known_limitations.impact: Convenient for a demo, confusing if an empty form is expected.

known_limitations.issue: Required fields are not visually marked as required, and several inputs have no placeholder.
known_limitations.impact: The visitor cannot tell which fields are optional before submitting.

known_limitations.issue: The favourite (heart) button on a tour card only holds state in the component and is never saved.
known_limitations.impact: Favourites disappear on navigation or reload.

known_limitations.issue: There is no admin interface. The admin API exists but no page consumes it.
known_limitations.impact: Bookings can only be inspected through the API or Prisma Studio.

known_limitations.issue: No e-mail is ever sent. The confirmation screen only tells the visitor to keep the reference.
known_limitations.impact: A visitor who loses the reference has no recovery path.

known_limitations.issue: All content is demo data. Prices, ratings, reviews and contact details are invented, and payment is simulated - a card ending in 0002 always declines.
known_limitations.impact: Nothing in the flow charges real money.
